CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  January 27, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael
  Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – January 13, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the January 13, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the January 13, 2026, Regular Meeting
  of the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chairman
  Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-167
  • 2415 South Fremont Avenue
  • Applicant: Yunfei Yang
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing
  1-story Colonial-style residence.

  1
  01/27/2026
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the application with the following considerations
  for approval:
  1. The applicant should continue to study the front entry and
  window design to provide greater emphasis on symmetry
  along the front façade. The Design Review Board seeks a
  more symmetrical composition in the porch area, particularly
  with respect to the front door and adjacent windows, to be
  consistent with the Colonial architectural character of the
  house. The Board is open to reviewing alternative design
  options for their subsequent review, if necessary.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-078
  • 2508 Loma Vista Drive
  • Applicant: Leo Chuang and Paul Hsu
  • Request: This is an application for the construction of a new 1,998
  SF 2-story single-family residence with an attached 588 SF two-car
  garage accessed at street level on a vacant hillside property. The
  proposed architectural style is Spanish Revival.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall update the Color & Material Board to
  include additional details for the proposed Spanish-style front
  door.
  2. The applicant shall revise the front entry roof design by either
  reducing the roof slope and/or overall height so that the
  parapet wall behind it can be exposed and extends higher
  than the shed roof element.
  3. The applicant shall revise the front entry west elevation
  opening to be proportional consistent in height with the
  primary front arched opening.

  2
  01/27/2026
   4. The applicant shall update the window schedule to accurately
  reflect the proposed red-brown window color as depicted on
  the Color & Material Board as opposed to white, which is
  currently shown for all windows.
  5. The applicant shall resubmit a revised plan set to the City
  Architect and City staff to verify compliance with these
  conditions and approval.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:47 P.M. to
  Tuesday, February 10, 2026, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Nora Hernandez
  Chairman
ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
